result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical content problem with an exposed localization key, and a minor text truncation issue.

issues.description: Exposed localization/i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' is visible instead of actual section title text
issues.suggestion: Replace the localization key with the properly translated section title (e.g., 'Popular near you', 'Popular restaurants', etc.) to display actual content to users

issues.description: Third restaurant name in 'Fastest near you' section is truncated - 'Trattoria Piccol' appears cut off
issues.suggestion: Ensure restaurant names have sufficient space to display fully, or implement text truncation with ellipsis in a more controlled manner (e.g., 'Trattoria Piccol...')
